subject: ALTERNATE RECORD KEY clause
notes: cite.py --check 12.4.5.6.4 "An ALTERNATE RECORD KEY clause specifies an alternate record key for the file" -> OK GR1. The clause is bound into FileModel.AlternateKeyNames (DataBinder.BindFileControl), emitted as CobolFile.AddAlternateKey per key in declaration order (KeyedIoEmitter / RuntimeApi.FileAddAlternateKey) and registered on the IndexedConnector as an ordered access path. Probes gr4.cob/gr5.cob: READ KEY IS alt and START KEY >= alt walk the alternate order. The covering golden l1_read_key_of_reference derives its expected output (prime order 01..04 vs alternate order AA(04)..DD(01)) from §14.9.30.4 GR30/GR31, so it witnesses that the clause established a distinct key path.
